$Comment: The Great Turkey's Boss Kill Claim: granted beside its daily Claim on every win, rolled from Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Chase, whose first roll always pays something. Diminish pays every win in full (one step of 1 that repeats), since each run already cost a Wishbone. It is not scaled by share (ShareScaled false), so everyone who fought it rolls the same odds, the chance at a Wishbone back included. TitleKey titles its row on the Claims tab and in the chest (claim.harvest_feast_great_turkey_chase in harvestfeast.progression.lang).
